Jack bought a hat at the shop yesterday. Jack borrowed a book about history from the park. There are always many people at the volunteer team. My daughter studies law at Exeter University.
Jack hopes to visit Chengdu one day. Jack and Lily had great fun there. Jack spent the weekend at the park. Best of all, she looks down on no one.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the game corner by bike. Both of them like noodles and tea. Jack learned a lot about history.
